operations.name: attach
operations.label: Attach Issue to Session
operations.description: Connect the calling Session to an Issue it is implementing, so the Issue's page lists it.

operations.name: detach
operations.label: Detach Issue from Session
operations.description: Disconnect the calling Session from an Issue it is no longer working on.

operations.name: chooseTracker
operations.label: Choose a Project's Issue tracker
operations.description: Choose which Tracker a Project's Issues come from, or none when no tracker is named.

tracker.description: The Tracker's id, such as github; leave it out for none.

operations.name: setStatus
operations.label: Set Issue status
operations.description: Close or reopen one Issue in a Project.

status.description: Whether the Issue is open or closed.

operations.name: signIn
operations.label: Sign in to GitHub
operations.description: Asks GitHub for a sign-in code, shows it on the sign-in page, and adds the Account once the person approves it on GitHub.

operations.name: cancelSignIn
operations.label: Cancel GitHub sign-in
operations.description: Stops waiting for the GitHub sign-in code to be approved.

capabilities.reason: Reads and changes Issues as the signed-in person, and is the host of the Account this Plugin provides.
Asks for the device sign-in code and exchanges it for a token.
